_README: Threat intelligence entries mapped to Microsoft Security Intelligence / MMPC and MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise documentation for the 21 public dataset families. Scope note: Family classification on static opcodes is not APT or ICS attribution.

ADLOAD.summary: Windows adware and unwanted software downloader (Adware:Win32/Adload) that alters browser proxy/search settings and fetches bundled payloads.
ADLOAD.confidence: medium: commodity adware/PUA family; not an APT or ICS threat group

AGENT.summary: Generic detection bucket (Trojan:Win32/Agent) covering diverse Windows trojans sharing common dropper, persistence, or C2 traits rather than a single codebase.
AGENT.confidence: low: generic multi-family detection label; requires binary-level triage

ALLAPLE_A.summary: Polymorphic, multi-threaded Windows network worm (Worm:Win32/Allaple.A) that spreads across SMB network shares and infects local executable/HTML files.
ALLAPLE_A.confidence: medium: well-documented legacy network worm; not APT-attributed

BHO.summary: Malicious or unwanted Browser Helper Object (Trojan/Adware:Win32/BHO) registered via COM CLSID keys to monitor Internet Explorer activity and inject content.
BHO.confidence: low: broad browser-extension behavior category; not APT-attributed

BIFROSE.summary: Classic Windows Remote Access Trojan (Backdoor:Win32/Bifrose / Bifrost) providing keylogging, credential harvesting, file management, and remote shell C2.
BIFROSE.confidence: medium: publicly available RAT builder used by diverse actors; builder match != attribution

CEEINJECT.summary: Generic obfuscator/crypter wrapper (VirTool:Win32/CeeInject) used to pack diverse underlying malware families and inject decoded payloads into host processes.
CEEINJECT.confidence: low: shared packer/crypter stub; underlying payload family cannot be inferred statically

CYCBOT_G.summary: Windows backdoor trojan (Backdoor:Win32/Cycbot.G) that connects to remote C2 servers, modifies host firewall/registry settings, and downloads secondary payloads.
CYCBOT_G.confidence: medium: commodity backdoor/bot family; not linked to ICS threat groups

FAKEREAN.summary: Rogue security software / scareware (Rogue:Win32/FakeRean) displaying fabricated infection warnings to coerce victims into purchasing fake antivirus licenses.
FAKEREAN.confidence: medium: financially motivated scareware family; not an APT group

HOTBAR.summary: Legacy browser toolbar adware (Adware:Win32/Hotbar) that hooks into Internet Explorer/Outlook to track browsing behavior and display targeted ads.
HOTBAR.confidence: low: commodity adware (note: only 12 samples in dataset / 2 in test split)

INJECTOR.summary: Generic heuristic classification (Trojan:Win32/Injector) for Windows executables that inject shellcode or DLL modules into legitimate running processes.
INJECTOR.confidence: low: behavioral/heuristic bucket spanning unrelated malware families

ONLINEGAMES.summary: Password-stealing trojan family (PWS:Win32/OnLineGames) targeting gaming account credentials via keylogging, API hooking, and removable-media autorun.
ONLINEGAMES.confidence: medium: financially motivated credential-theft crimeware; not APT-attributed

RENOS.summary: Trojan downloader (TrojanDownloader:Win32/Renos) often disguised as a media codec that fetches rogue antivirus payloads (e.g., FakeRean/Winwebsec).
RENOS.confidence: medium: commodity downloader linked to scareware distribution

RIMECUD_A.summary: Multi-component Windows worm (Worm:Win32/Rimecud.A) spreading via removable drives and messaging clients while exposing a backdoor for remote payload execution.
RIMECUD_A.confidence: medium: commodity worm family (note: small support of 10 test samples)

SMALL.summary: Generic family label (TrojanDownloader:Win32/Small) for compact stub downloaders engineered to fetch and execute larger second-stage payloads over HTTP.
SMALL.confidence: low: size-based downloader category spanning multiple authors

TOGA_RFN.summary: Generic Microsoft heuristic signature (Trojan:Win32/Toga!rfn) flagging PE binaries with suspicious obfuscation, persistence, or C2 characteristics.
TOGA_RFN.confidence: low: heuristic signature bucket rather than a single malware lineage

VB.summary: Generic detection category (Trojan/Worm:Win32/VB) for malware compiled in Visual Basic (P-Code or native runtime), spanning downloaders, worms, and RATs.
VB.confidence: low: compiler/runtime-based grouping; not a single threat actor

VBINJECT.summary: Visual Basic crypter/packer wrapper (VirTool:Win32/VBInject) that decrypts an embedded payload in memory and injects it into a target Windows process.
VBINJECT.confidence: low: shared crypter stub used across many unrelated malware families

VOBFUS.summary: Visual Basic worm family (Worm:Win32/Vobfus) propagating via removable drives and network shares while continuously downloading polymorphic updates and secondary malware.
VOBFUS.confidence: medium: well-documented self-updating worm family; not ICS-specific

VUNDO.summary: Multi-stage Windows trojan and downloader (Trojan:Win32/Vundo) using DLL injection into explorer.exe/browsers and resilient registry persistence.
VUNDO.confidence: medium: commodity trojan/downloader family; not APT-attributed

WINWEBSEC.summary: Widespread rogue antivirus / scareware family (Rogue:Win32/Winwebsec) impersonating Windows security alerts to defraud users into buying fake cleanup tools.
WINWEBSEC.confidence: medium: financially motivated scareware family; not an APT group

ZBOT.summary: Zeus modular banking trojan (PWS:Win32/Zbot / MITRE Software S0330) utilizing browser form-grabbing and web-injects to steal financial and login credentials.
ZBOT.confidence: medium: leaked Zeus source code spawned numerous independent cybercrime operators
